vrm_placement_policy.accepted: Fully seated inside socket, including centered or lateral placement

included.criterion: Expected component absent from its assigned slot; ambiguous appearance is UNKNOWN.
Wrong GPU/HBM reference-dot corner, wrong inductor black-marker direction, or clearly wrong supported component orientation.
Clearly outside socket or clearly rotated/lip-seated, with validated position evidence. Boundary-only uncertain cases are UNKNOWN.
Clearly visible missing/collapsed white pin with validated evidence. Unavailable HBM pin checks are UNKNOWN.
Visible scratch/damage supported under validated imaging conditions; an anomaly heatmap alone is not confirmed damage.

decision_policy.PASS: All mandatory stages calibrated, available and PASS under the existing fusion contract.
decision_policy.FAIL: At least one calibrated authoritative check confirms a defect.
decision_policy.UNKNOWN: Missing, unverified, ambiguous, contradictory or low-confidence evidence.

unknown_workflow.note: triggered_inspection_once.py recaptures UNKNOWN once; local event recommends HOLD without commanding equipment. Full physical/Sequencer hold integration unverified.

freeze.remaining_work: Fix reproducible execution defects and verify agreed scope; do not expand subtle-defect claims to meet deadline.
